primitives.name: Cylindrical Measure Extension
primitives.verbatim_quote: If μ is a set function on F such that, for each positive integer n, μ is a probability measure on Fn, then μ has a unique extension to a probability measure on S.

primitives.assumptions: Each finite-dimensional projection μ_n is a probability measure; F is closed under finite unions and intersections.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when general measure-theoretic analogs do not hold due to topological constraints.

layer2.mapping: The extension maps finite-dimensional cylinder measures into a consistent infinite-dimensional probability space via σ-ring closure.
layer2.telemetry: Verification via countable additivity and uniqueness of extended measure.
